_comment: Owner-maintained map from a message template to the workflow that sends it (owner list of 2026-10-15). GHL does not record the workflow on a message, so the dashboard cannot work this out by itself. templateStartsWith is the template's opening text as written in the workflow; merge fields are allowed: {{contact.first_name}} is treated as a removed name and {{user.first_name}} as any one word (the rep's name). The cards compare the opening words of each sent message with these entries; the longest matching entry wins. Leave workflow blank to hide an entry. Templates not listed here show as 'Not mapped yet'.

mappings.templateStartsWith: Hey {{contact.first_name}}, this is {{user.first_name}} at Veteran Careers Network. We saw you had requested more info regarding the $2k in Free Cybersecurity training offered by the Army.
